title: FBI Open Up
blurb: FBI OPEN UP — the door-splintering announcement followed by implied chaos. The meme plays it whenever someone types, says, or searches something questionable: the joke is that the feds were already outside. As a prank sound it's elite — few audio clips make people physically look at their own front door. Use with a subwoofer for federal-grade impact.
origin: The meme raid announcement, popularized by gaming and Discord culture.
